02 / HOW I BUILD

Beyond making it work.

Software for real use starts with a clear problem
and stays useful through thoughtful maintenance.

01

Understand the structure

Identify where complexity and friction come from. Turn the problem into something tractable before adding more features.

02

Keep it simple and explicit

Choose designs whose intent is easy to understand. Consider performance alongside ease of change and long-term maintainability.

03

Build, test, improve

Develop tools and utilities from practical problems. Iterate through implementation and verification to make them useful.

CLARITY → IMPLEMENTATION → ITERATION✳
